claudeReadyContextPayload.contextSummary:
Tenant: meridian-health
Module: moves
Purpose: phase_readiness
Agent Assist / Member Service context assembled for moves (customer_service_ai): 5 evidence refs are available; all remain synthetic review evidence until tenant validation and promotion.
Profiles: enterprise:Meridian Health; function:Member Service and Contact Center; use_case:AI-enabled agent assist for member service and contact-center workflows; system:Genesys Cloud; system:Salesforce Health Cloud; system:Claims administration platform; system:Eligibility and benefits platform; system:Knowledge base and call transcript store
Key facts: pain_point=Agents search Salesforce cases, benefits notes, prior-auth status, and claims inquiry screens separately while the member waits on the call.; pain_point=Call transcript intent labels are inconsistent across billing, eligibility, claims status, and prior authorization categories.; pain_point=Genesys call metadata and Salesforce case outcomes are not reliably joined to claims and benefits context.; pain_point=Knowledge articles are duplicated across operations playbooks and CRM snippets, creating conflicting guidance for appeal and denial inquiries.; pain_point=Supervisors cannot prove whether AI suggestions reduce handle time without a baseline for after-call work, transfer rate, and first-contact resolution.; metric=Average handle time by intent; metric=First contact resolution for claims-status calls; metric=After-call work minutes per agent shift
Relationships: depends_on:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Meridian Health for the customer_service_ai request.; uses:Member Service and Contact Center connects to AI-enabled agent assist for member service and contact-center workflows for the customer_service_ai request.; depends_on:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Genesys Cloud for the customer_service_ai request.; uses:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Salesforce Health Cloud for the customer_service_ai request.; depends_on:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Claims administration platform for the customer_service_ai request.; uses:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Eligibility and benefits platform for the customer_service_ai request.; depends_on:Member Service and Contact Center connects to Knowledge base and call transcript store for the customer_service_ai request.; uses:Member Service and Contact Center connects to call transcript for the customer_service_ai request.
Metrics: Average handle time by intent; First contact resolution for claims-status calls; After-call work minutes per agent shift
Risks/controls: PHI handling; human-in-the-loop approval; stale knowledge article duplicates
Evidence summary: Genesys call sample with queue, intent, handle time, transfer flag, and after-call-work fields.; Salesforce Health Cloud case extract with member inquiry categories and resolution dispositions.; Call transcript annotation sample for billing, eligibility, claims status, and prior authorization intents.; Knowledge article export with duplicate and stale article flags.; Member service KPI baseline for AHT, FCR, transfer rate, complaint escalation, and quality score.
Confidence: good - The cluster has enough semantic depth for dry-run context assembly, but remains synthetic review context with candidate relationship edges.
Known gaps: intent taxonomy drift; CRM-to-claims join gaps; stale knowledge article duplicates; Relationship candidates are preserved for context assembly, but are not treated as validated active graph truth.
Recommended next evidence: source-owner attestation; measured baseline extract; relationship validation; operator promotion review
